svg.title: From private accusations to a workable agreement
svg.desc: A hypothetical workshop team addresses agenda changes made after staff briefings. Maya privately thinks Theo blocks every change; Theo thinks Maya ignores the work already done. A direct conversation starts with an observable event: the agenda changed after the staff briefing. They ask how changes should be handled. Maya explains participant needs; Theo explains that staff are already using the briefing. They agree that Maya will send explicit requests with staffing implications, Theo will confirm feasibility, the lead will decide unresolved trade-offs, and they will review the agreement after two workshops. Understanding both accounts does not require equal blame. This depicts an ordinary work disagreement where direct discussion is appropriate.

g.text: From private accusations to a workable agreement
Hypothetical workshop team · Name the issue, hear both accounts, agree what changes
“The agenda changed after the staff briefing.
Can we agree how to handle changes at that point?”
Maya sends explicit change requests with staffing implications.
Theo confirms feasibility; the lead decides unresolved trade-offs.
They review the arrangement after two workshops.
Understanding both accounts does not require equal blame.
Fictional dialogue and review period · Ordinary work disagreement where direct discussion is appropriate
